title: Plan executable P2-002 IntelligenceProvider contracts
businessObjective: Prepare a bounded provider-neutral intelligence contract before any model provider, gateway, workflow, proposal, or execution capability is introduced.
technicalObjective: Define the finite V1 IntelligenceProvider request/result authorities, conceptual port, exact validator, fail-closed behavior, and corrected P2-002 packet; do not implement schemas, validation code, a provider, gateway, adapter, workflow, proposal generator, or runtime capability.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P2-002 consumes only bounded prepared evidence references and never fetches, stores, or mutates evidence.
P2-001 output may be referenced as prepared evidence but P2-002 does not import its internal validation or numerical implementation.

P2-001-R02 establishes that Draft 2020-12 supplies structural schema assurance while the P2-001 deep module enforces documented semantic ordering; P2-002 must preserve that distinction and cannot treat schema acceptance alone as proof of P2-001 semantic validity.
Provider invocation, provider-specific adapters, orchestration, proposals, policy, approval, execution, verification, and audit persistence remain later tasks.
Exact verifier admission remains a separate governance action.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design specifies exactly two closed V1 JSON Schema authorities, the small conceptual IntelligenceProvider port, and one deterministic Node validator.

Prepared analytics evidence can cite P2-001 results only after the canonical P2-001 public function and its R02-assured structural-plus-semantic boundary produced a valid result; P2-002 neither revalidates through weaker replacement schemas nor reinterprets calculator semantics.
The design fixes finite request and result variants, fields, enums, bounds, evidence-reference rules, confidence semantics, provider states, reason codes, and validation precedence.

The boundary is provider-neutral, fail closed, and non-authoritative; it contains no provider SDK, storage locator, scheduler, workflow, policy, approval, execution, verification, or audit-source-of-truth interface.
The P2-002 packet is amended only to the designed static-contract scope and names its exact future Node validator command.
The design requires separately approved exact shell-free verifier admission with near-miss rejection coverage.
Independent QA can confirm no product implementation, schema, validator, verifier, CI, runtime, protected path, or historical evidence was altered.
requiredChecks: P2-002 packet scope and dependency review
solEscalationTriggers: Any design permits caller-supplied authority, provider-specific dependencies in the core, or leakage of storage, transport, validation, or provider SDK internals.
Any live data, credential, guest data, provider invocation, proposal, authorization, approval, execution, production write, payment, booking, RLS, migration, concurrency, or workflow proposal.
Any ambiguity about malformed-input behavior, provider-state mapping, reason-code precedence, data classification, or future verifier admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this planning design, P2-002 packet amendment, GOV-040 state, risk entry if added, and evidence; preserve completed records, canonical sources, P1/P2-001 authorities, and runtime surfaces.

stateTransitions.reason: P2-001 and P1-004 are done and the bounded P2-002 architecture-planning scope, paths, and checks are specified.
Begin approved P2-002 contract planning in the isolated GOV-040 worktree.

Finite provider-neutral V1 request/result authorities, semantic contract boundary, P2-001-R02 assurance dependency, fail-closed behavior, corrected P2-002 packet, and planning evidence pass all packet-authorized checks and are ready for fresh independent Sol QA.

Independent Sol QA confirmed the finite two-schema and one-module plan, P2-001-R02 boundary, provider-neutral deep-module architecture, fail-closed non-authority behavior, human gates, scope, rollback, and single machine verification pass.
